How to use Palette

Upload or drop an image, or paste one from your clipboard. Palette groups similar pixels into 4 to 12 main colours and connects each label to a matching point in your image.

Drag a colour point to sample a new pixel; its hex, name and swatch update as you move. Lines rearrange automatically. You can also focus a point and use the arrow keys (Shift moves ten pixels). Use the zoom buttons or scroll over the image to zoom in. Drag the image to pan when zoomed in, and use Fit to see the whole image again. Click the image to add an exact-pixel point. Click a colour to copy its hex, or export the whole palette. Names describe the nearest named colour; hex codes are the precise values.

Everything happens in your browser. Your images are never uploaded.
